analysis: The code snippet calls `startupContainer.getComponentsByType(IndexSynchronizer.class).get(0)`. The `get` method is from a Java `List` and throws `IndexOutOfBoundsException` if the index is out of range (index < 0 || index >= size()). Here index is 0, so the exception is thrown if the list is empty (size == 0). The code does not perform any check to ensure the list is non-empty before calling `get(0)`. Therefore, the exception condition is not avoided.
remark: The `IndexOutOfBoundsException` can be triggered if `getComponentsByType(IndexSynchronizer.class)` returns an empty list, meaning no `IndexSynchronizer` component was registered or found. The code directly accesses index 0 without verifying the list size, so if the list is empty, the exception will be thrown.
